decisions.reason: After several years without visible website presence, this adjacent product line likely no longer meets aspiration as a standalone offer, so management would reallocate resources to stronger core systems and newer development.
Its strong fit with the firm's modular formwork portfolio and likely role in bundled system sales make it more likely to remain above aspiration, especially in a growing firm with some slack.
Although its visibility appears reduced, this closely related magnetic formwork component can still support installed-base and package sales, so continuation is slightly more likely than withdrawal.
